title: Return Configurations Stay Fixed
statement: For every bit-list input $x$, every configuration of the increment machine on $x$ in the return state, and every natural number $t$, running the machine from that configuration for $t$ steps leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the increment machine on $x$
The control state of $c$ is the return state
replaced: For every configuration of the increment machine in the return control and every duration $t$, running for $t$ steps leaves the whole configuration, not merely its control, unchanged.
